title: Mahasu Pahari - Wikipedia
text: Mahasu Pahari is a Western Pahari language spoken in Himachal Pradesh. It is also known as Mahasui or Mahasuvi. The speaking population is about 1,000,000.

title: Mahasu Pahari
text: Mahasu Pahari, a cluster of Western Pahari dialects within the Indo-Aryan language family, originated in the western Himalayan foothills through the evolution of early Indo-Aryan speech forms blended with local substrates.
